create_episode: create an Episode with start_position, start_rotation, scene_id, and episode_id for a habitat simulation
create_dataset: build a Dataset subclass to manage a collection of Episode objects for embodied AI tasks
get_scene_episodes: get all episodes from a Dataset filtered by a specific scene_id
get_splits: split a Dataset into multiple subsets with options for collating scene ids and uneven splits
create_episode_iterator: create an EpisodeIterator to cycle through episodes with scene grouping, shuffling, and max scene repeat controls
